newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nikko rates Shanghai Haixin a buy.
newsitem.headline: Nikko rates Shanghai Haixin a buy.

text.p: Nikko Research has initiated its coverage of plush manufacturer Shanghai Haixin group with a "buy" recommendation, Nikko said on Friday.
Shanghai Haixin Group is one of China's largest manufacturers of plush. Nikko said the United States is Haixin's largest export market, accounting for 60 percent of its output.
Nikko said the company's net profit is expected to increase by about 30 percent year-on-year to 98 million renminbi in 1997.
It said that the company's production expansion, a 15 million renminbi increase in subsidiary contributions and lower raw material prices will underpin the increased earnings.

Nikko said that because Haixin's stock currently is trading at an "undemanding" prospective price earnings ratio of 9.3 times fiscal year 1997 earnings and 8.0 times fiscal year 1998 earnings it recommends a "buy."
